assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create exactly nine small first-grade arcade illustrations in one transparent three-by-three grid. One isolated illustration per equal cell, centered, at most 74% of the cell width and height. Leave genuine alpha outside every illustration and between cells. No outlines between cells, grids, ground shadows, lettering, digits, symbols, signatures, brands, or labels. Use warm fine paper grain, matte gouache, bold clean cut-paper forms, teal, warm cream, apricot. Clear silhouettes are essential for small-screen material.
R1C1: one wide bright burnt-orange art album, partially open just enough to show thick clean ivory pages. The cover is plain and rectangular. No writing, no illustration on the cover.
R1C2: one squat flat violet school eraser, solid rectangular silhouette with a pale lavender edge, no wrapper or text.
R1C3: one short capped pale blue upright water bottle, smooth rounded body and the muted golden screw cap; match the schoolbag bottle style. No label.
R2C1: one simple orange ribbon roll face-on with a large central opening and one tiny loose end attached to the roll, no second object.
R2C2: one cream paper map folded into two visible angled panels, with a muted teal curving path, no place names, characters, landmarks or marks.
R2C3: close-up cutaway of the wide main cavity of one dark-teal school backpack with cream zipper edging. Broad horizontal opening with a plain orange album resting flat at its base; show the visual width of the opening.
R3C1: close-up of one shallow front zipper pocket of the same dark-teal backpack. Clearly separate long muted gold zipper pull and an orange ribbon roll inside. Show only that one pocket, no large book, and distinguish from the open main compartment.
R3C2: close-up of one tapered side mesh pocket of the same dark-teal backpack, crosshatched mesh and teal seam, with the same pale blue bottle visibly upright inside and the muted gold cap exposed. No text.
R3C3: one simple empty pale cream-sage rectangular work mat texture, soft fine paper grain, light beige-green matte tabletop with quiet corners, no seams, lines, markings or objects. Isolate the rectangle with truly transparent margin.
